definitions.gloss: being the first to arrive; being first in
definitions.explanation: Arriving somewhere before anyone else, or being the first to reach a goal or enter a new field. Often used with する or を{果|は}たす.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今朝|けさ}→今朝：02877_kesa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一番乗|いちばんの}り⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This morning I was the first to arrive at the office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{開店日|かいてんび}、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦{五時|ごじ}→五時：30899_goji⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{並|なら}んで→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧{一番乗|いちばんの}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: On the new shop's opening day, he lined up from five in the morning and was the first one in.

notes:
Originally the first warrior to ride (⟦{乗|の}り{込|こ}む→乗り込む：04618_norikomu⟧) into an enemy castle; now used lightly of being first anywhere.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一番乗|いちばんの}り⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be the first to arrive
- {一番乗|いちばんの}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧: to manage to be first
- {一番乗|いちばんの}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧: to aim to be first
